E2416

`env.decode` could not build the typed config; the error names the source environment variable and field path.

What

`env.decode` could not build the typed config; the error names the source environment variable and field path.

Why

Runtime config decoding uses the shared `__jet_Decode` codec, so a bad value, missing field, or unknown field is reported at its typed path while secret values stay redacted (D-CONFIG-ENV1).

Fix

Fix the named environment variable or field path, or adjust `prefix:`, `file:`, and `allow:` so the intended source reaches the typed record.
